plans.query: SELECT i.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_shop_items o WHERE o.user_id=$1 AND o.shop_item_id=i.id) AS owned FROM shop_items i WHERE i.slot='CHARACTER' AND $2 AND ($3 OR NOT i.test_only) AND ($4 OR NOT i.remote_only) AND ((i.active AND NOT i.earn_only) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_shop_items o WHERE o.user_id=$5 AND o.shop_item_id=i.id))  ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id LIMIT $6

Plans.Filter: ((NOT test_only) AND (slot = 'CHARACTER'::"AccessorySlot") AND ((active AND (NOT earn_only)) OR (hashed SubPlan 4)))

plans.query:
SELECT u.coins, u.appearance_revision AS "appearanceRevision",
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'slot',e.slot,'shopItemId',e.shop_item_id,'updatedAt',e.updated_at,'shopItem',to_jsonb(i))) FROM user_equipped_accessories e JOIN shop_items i ON i.id=e.shop_item_id WHERE e.user_id=u.id),'[]') AS equipment,
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',w.id,'characterKey',w.character_key,'revision',w.revision,'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slot',wi.slot,'shopItemId',wi.shop_item_id,'shopItem',to_jsonb(i))) FROM character_wardrobe_items wi JOIN shop_items i ON i.id=wi.shop_item_id WHERE wi.wardrobe_id=w.id),'[]'))) FROM character_wardrobes w WHERE w.user_id=u.id AND (w.character_key=ANY($1::text[]) OR w.character_key=COALESCE((SELECT e.shop_item_id FROM user_equipped_accessories e WHERE e.user_id=u.id AND e.slot='CHARACTER'),'default'))),'[]') AS wardrobes
 FROM users u WHERE u.id=$2

SELECT u.coins, u.appearance_revision AS "appearanceRevision",
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'slot',e.slot,'shopItemId',e.shop_item_id,'updatedAt',e.updated_at,'shopItem',to_jsonb(i))) FROM user_equipped_accessories e JOIN shop_items i ON i.id=e.shop_item_id WHERE e.user_id=u.id),'[]') AS equipment,
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',w.id,'characterKey',w.character_key,'revision',w.revision,'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slot',wi.slot,'shopItemId',wi.shop_item_id,'shopItem',to_jsonb(i))) FROM character_wardrobe_items wi JOIN shop_items i ON i.id=wi.shop_item_id WHERE wi.wardrobe_id=w.id),'[]'))) FROM character_wardrobes w WHERE w.user_id=u.id AND (w.character_key=ANY($1::text[]) OR w.character_key=COALESCE((SELECT e.shop_item_id FROM user_equipped_accessories e WHERE e.user_id=u.id AND e.slot='CHARACTER'),'default'))),'[]') AS wardrobes
 FROM users u WHERE u.id=$2

SELECT i.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_shop_items o WHERE o.user_id=$1 AND o.shop_item_id=i.id) AS owned, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_item_character_fits f WHERE f.accessory_shop_item_id=i.id AND f.character_key=$2) AS approved FROM shop_items i WHERE i.slot<>'CHARACTER' AND ($3 OR NOT i.test_only) AND ($4 OR NOT i.remote_only) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_shop_items o WHERE o.user_id=$5 AND o.shop_item_id=i.id) OR i.id=ANY($6::text[]) OR (i.active AND NOT i.earn_only AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_item_character_fits f WHERE f.accessory_shop_item_id=i.id AND f.character_key=$7)))  ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id LIMIT $8

Plans.Filter: ((NOT test_only) AND (slot <> 'CHARACTER'::"AccessorySlot") AND ((hashed SubPlan 6) OR (id = ANY ('{}'::text[])) OR (active AND (NOT earn_only) AND (hashed SubPlan 8))))
